name: sfv/registration-form
title: Registration Form
description: The Surfing for Vision registration form with the release agreement. Shows a thank-you message after someone registers, and a "registration opens soon" message while registration is closed.

successHeading.default: Thanks for Registering for Surfing for Vision 2026!

successMessage.default: You will receive a confirmation email shortly.

closedMessage.default:
Registration for the next Surfing for Vision isn’t open yet. Check back soon, or follow @surfingforvision on Instagram to hear the moment it opens.

In the meantime, you can help keep the day free for every surfer.
